experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Their post-transplant course was complicated with several bacterial infections, resulting in dramatic changes in the plasma proteome, especially in acute phase protein concentrations.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: For both of these donors, plasma was obtained from 3 consecutive samplings, each time a month apart.

number_of_fractions.evidence: The fractions with molecular weight between ∼1 kDa and ∼2 MDa were selected for analysis from all time points of all samples, cumulating in to 66 fractions per time point.

number_of_samples.evidence: For P1 we obtained nine post-transplantation EDTA plasma samples (named T1–T9), and for P2 four (named T1–T4).

technology_type.evidence: experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics
